definitions.explanation: A polite demonstrative for a direction or location far from both speaker and listener.
A polite way to refer to a third party.

examples.japanese: ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あちらです。
あちら⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
あちら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧お⟦{出|で}→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please exit from that door over there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あちら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{五分|ごふん}→五分：09573_gofun⟧⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧です。
examples.english: The station is about a five-minute walk in that direction.

examples.japanese: あちら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧たちの⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧です。⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧でご⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧いたします。
examples.english: That tall building you can see over there is our hotel. I will show you there later.

examples.japanese: あちら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どなた→どなた：02923_donata⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
あちら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧です。
examples.english: That person is the company president.

examples.japanese: あちら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
あちら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦いらっしゃった→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧です。
examples.english: That person is a customer who came for the first time today.

examples.japanese: あちら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{山田|やまだ}⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥様|おくさま}→奥様：12337_okusama⟧で、⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦いらっしゃいました→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧。
examples.english: That person is Professor Yamada's wife, who was teaching at the university until last year.

notes:
あちら is the polite form of あそこ (over there), part of the こそあど demonstrative system.

KO-SO-A-DO SYSTEM (polite):
- こちら: here, this way (near speaker)
- そちら: there, that way (near listener)
- あちら: over there (far from both)
- どちら: where? which way?

USES:
1. Direction/location: トイレはあちらです (The restroom is over there)
2. Polite person reference: あちらの{方|かた} (that person)

CONTEXT:
Commonly heard in service environments—department stores, hotels, restaurants. Using あちら instead of あそこ shows politeness to customers.

NOTE:
When referring to people, using あちら alone or あちらの{方|かた} is polite. あの{人|ひと} is more casual.
